description:
Create 'Related' links between specific pairs of papers in your Zotero library to map their intellectual lineage. You must create 5 specific bidirectional links.

REQUIRED PAIRS:
1. 'Attention Is All You Need' <-> 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding'
2. 'Attention Is All You Need' <-> 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners'
3. 'Deep Learning' (LeCun et al.) <-> 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks'
4. 'Deep Learning' (LeCun et al.) <-> 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition'
5. 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks' <-> 'Generative Adversarial Nets'

HOW TO DO IT:
1. Select the first paper in the pair.
2. Go to the 'Related' tab in the right-hand panel.
3. Click 'Add' and search for the second paper title.
4. Select it and click OK.

Note: Zotero automatically makes the link bidirectional, so you only need to add it from one side.

required_pairs: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
